line: Crowley's Atu VI: Gemini under Mercury, the letter Zain, and the path from Binah to Tiphareth, with the figure's analysis and synthesis.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Gemini, ruled by Mercury; the letter Zain, a sword; more than one figure in the card.

quotes.quote: Atu VI refers to Gemini, ruled by Mercury. It means The Twins. The Hebrew letter corresponding is Zain, which means a Sword,
It is the first card in which more than one figure appears.

sections.title: Its path on the Tree
sections.line: Gemini leads from Binah to Tiphareth, in the Lovers chapter and again in the Ace of Swords chapter. Crowley numbers the ends 3 and 6. The Key Scale gives path 17.

quotes.quote: Gemini leads from Binah to Tiphareth.
leads from the number 3 to the number 6.
his mother Binah through the Path of Zain, the sublime intuitive sense,

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: Crowley's account of the card's subject, and of the Art card that completes the marriage it begins.

quotes.quote: The subject of this card is Analysis, followed by Synthesis.
This card represents the Consummation of the Royal Marriage which took place in Atu VI.
